name: application-table-loading-skeleton
title: Table Loading Skeleton
description: Shimmering placeholder table rows that match the real column layout, with the header kept intact and a real table structure so the loading state doesn't shift layout on load.
useWhen: A data table's rows are still fetching and you want a loading state shaped exactly like the real table, headers included.
You want to avoid layout shift between the loading state and the loaded table by reusing the same <table>/<thead>/<tbody> structure.
Varying placeholder bar widths per row would help it read as "data-shaped" rather than a uniform gray block.
avoidWhen: You're skeletoning a card grid, not a table — use `skeleton-card-list` for that unrelated layout.
The table is genuinely empty (zero rows, fetch succeeded) — use `Table Empty State` instead; showing a skeleton forever misleads the user into thinking data is still coming.
A fetch failed — use `Table Error State` with a retry action rather than leaving a skeleton indefinitely.
responsiveBehavior: Table wrapper scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via its containing overflow rather than compressing columns; placeholder bar widths stay fixed per column so the skeleton's shape doesn't reflow at different sizes.
accessibility: The table carries role=status and an aria-label announcing the loading state, plus a visually hidden sr-only text node, so assistive tech announces progress rather than reading placeholder bars as content.
The real column headers stay visible during loading, so users already know what the incoming data will represent.
Placeholder bars use animate-pulse rather than a moving shimmer gradient, respecting prefers-reduced-motion by default since pulse opacity change is Tailwind's built-in reduced-motion-safe animation.

variants.title: Table Loading Skeleton
variants.description: Four-column table header (Name/Owner/Status/Last updated) with four shimmering placeholder rows of varying widths.
accessibility: Status column placeholders use a pill shape (rounded-full) distinct from the rectangular text placeholders, previewing the real status-badge shape before data arrives.

variants.title: Table Loading Skeleton (Dark)
variants.description: Table loading skeleton adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Placeholder bar color is tuned to remain visible without glaring against the dark surface.
